comment_ports: Stable interface/port names wired by the generic recipe for Versal. Control master is M_AXI_FPD on CIPS, connecting to VTA ctrl via SmartConnect. DRAM master connects to S06_AXI on the AXI NoC, which connects to DDR memory controller ports on the board.
comment_addresses: Address space mapping including CIPS internal mappings to DDR via NoC, and VTA memory/control segments.
